title: GoPro HERO8 + HERO10 Bundle Negotiation
originalQuestion: Is there a worthwhile deal available by negotiating these two GoPro listings as a bundle?
desiredResult: Acquire useful GoPro equipment at a favorable total package value while controlling downside risk.

actualOutcome.description: Purchase completed successfully for AUD $400 total: GoPro HERO8, GoPro HERO10, HERO10-associated tripod, three HERO8-associated batteries, HERO8-associated charging dock, and a 3-month warranty.

outcomeNotes: Final bundle contained the GoPro HERO8, GoPro HERO10, HERO10 tripod, three HERO8 batteries, HERO8 charging dock, and 3-month warranty.
The supplied facts state that the purchase completed successfully; they do not provide further camera-condition detail or accessory market values.

Calibration observation: the opportunity emerged by connecting two separately listed items from the same seller, which the unchanged engine does not explicitly model as cross-listing economic structure.
